name: Katun
description: The legendary crown jewel of Mirabilandia and one of the most celebrated inverted roller coasters in European theme park history — Katun is a Bolliger and Mabillard inverted coaster that stands 50 metres tall and reaches 110 km/h across a spectacular 1,110-metre layout through six inversions including a massive loop, zero-gravity roll, cobra roll and two corkscrews. For many years ranked as the number one inverted coaster in Europe by enthusiast polls, Katun delivers an extraordinary combination of speed, sustained g-forces and graceful inversion sequences that make it one of the most complete and rewarding coaster experiences in Italy. Riders hang beneath the track with legs freely dangling as Katun tears through its Mayan-themed landscape with relentless fury. Min. height: 140cm.

name: iSpeed
description: Italy's fastest and tallest roller coaster and one of the most thrilling launched coasters in Europe — iSpeed is an Intamin launch coaster that accelerates from 0 to 100 km/h in a breathtaking 2.2 seconds before soaring to 55 metres at a maximum speed of 120 km/h. The combination of violent hydraulic launch, massive airtime hills and the breathtaking top hat element makes iSpeed a genuinely world-class coaster experience. When it opened in 2009 it was the fastest roller coaster in Italy and it remains the benchmark against which all Italian coasters are measured. The theming draws inspiration from motorsport and speed culture. Min. height: 140cm.

name: Divertical
description: A world record holder and one of the most visually dramatic attractions at any European theme park — Divertical is the world's tallest water coaster, standing an extraordinary 60 metres above the Adriatic coastline and delivering a breathtaking vertical drop that generates a final wave 15 metres high at the base. Designed by Intamin, Divertical sends riders on a boat-like vehicle up a steep incline before releasing them in a near-vertical plunge that is guaranteed to leave every single rider completely drenched. The 60-metre height gives Divertical views across the entire Po Delta and the Adriatic Sea. One of the most unique and spectacular water attractions in European theme park history. Min. height: 140cm.

name: Desmo Race
description: A genuinely unique attraction that exists nowhere else on earth — Desmo Race is the world's only spike dueling coaster, a Mack Rides creation in the Ducati World area where two separate coaster trains race each other on parallel tracks that share a single bidirectional spike element. Riders on one train watch the other train approach them head-on before both trains reverse and race back in the opposite direction in a thrilling automotive duel inspired by the legendary Ducati Desmosedici MotoGP racing motorcycle. The combination of genuine racing spectacle, Ducati branding and the unique spike track format makes Desmo Race a completely unmissable and historically significant attraction. Min. height: 120cm.

name: Master Thai
description: Italy's first and only double-track dueling roller coaster — Master Thai sends two trains racing simultaneously on parallel tracks through a shared layout of inversions, dips and high-speed turns in a genuinely competitive dueling format where the two trains interact and near-miss each other throughout. The Thai martial arts theming creates an atmospheric and visually distinctive setting and the sheer excitement of watching the opposing train race alongside during every twist and inversion makes Master Thai one of the most engaging coaster experiences in Italy. Min. height: 120cm.

name: El Dorado Falls
description: The most dramatic water ride at Mirabilandia — El Dorado Falls drops riders from a breathtaking 27 metres at 70 km/h into a spectacular wall of water that rises an astonishing 15 metres high at the base of the drop. Themed to the legendary lost city of El Dorado and its daredevil settlers who once braved America's most famous waterfalls, El Dorado Falls delivers the most intense log flume drop experience available at any Italian theme park. The immersive western frontier theming throughout the queue and ride area enhances the atmosphere and makes this far more than a simple water ride. Min. height: 100cm.

name: Rio Bravo
description: A breathtaking white water river rapids ride through the most dramatic landscape in Mirabilandia — Rio Bravo sends circular rafts through churning white water rapids, rocky canyon walls and past dramatic waterfalls in one of the most atmospheric and genuinely thrilling river raft experiences at any Italian theme park. The combination of genuine hydraulic turbulence, spectacular rocky scenery and the constant threat of complete drenching makes Rio Bravo consistently one of the most popular summer attractions at Mirabilandia. Min. height: 100cm.

name: Reset
description: Italy's first interactive dark ride and one of the most atmospheric and technologically sophisticated attractions at Mirabilandia — Reset plunges riders into the underground ruins of a post-apocalyptic New York City where they must shoot laser targets across 11 spectacular scenes to combat the forces threatening what remains of civilisation. The combination of genuinely impressive post-apocalyptic set design, competitive scoring gameplay and the atmospheric IMAscore soundtrack makes Reset one of the most replayable and talked-about dark ride attractions in Italy. Min. height: 90cm with adult.

name: Eurowheel
description: Continental Europe's second tallest Ferris wheel at a remarkable 92 metres — Eurowheel towers over the entire Mirabilandia resort and the surrounding Po Delta nature reserve, providing breathtaking panoramic views across the Adriatic Sea, the Ravenna coastline, the pine groves of Classe and on clear days the distant Apennine mountains. Eurowheel is the most iconic visual landmark at Mirabilandia and one of the finest observation experiences at any Italian theme park — the combination of maritime and natural landscape views from the gondola is uniquely spectacular. Suitable for all ages.

name: The Walking Dead
description: A terrifying indoor walking attraction themed to the globally beloved AMC television series The Walking Dead — guests enter on foot through a series of elaborately themed post-apocalyptic corridors and rooms filled with atmospheric effects, startling scares and encounters with walkers in an experience that tests the nerve of even the most hardened horror fans. The Walking Dead is Mirabilandia's premier scare attraction and draws particularly large queues during the park's highly popular Halloween Fright Nights event season. Not recommended for nervous visitors or young children. Min. height: 140cm.

name: Nickelodeon Land
description: The brand-new star of Mirabilandia's 2025 season and the winner of the Parksmania Award for Best Italian Park Creation 2025 — Nickelodeon Land is the first area in Italy entirely dedicated to beloved Nickelodeon characters including SpongeBob and Patrick, the Ninja Turtles, Dora the Explorer and PAW Patrol. The area features exciting family rides, themed attractions, character meet-and-greets and dedicated dining spots all wrapped in the distinctive colourful Nickelodeon aesthetic. Nickelodeon Land has transformed Mirabilandia's offering for younger families and created a destination experience that was previously unavailable anywhere in Italy. Suitable for all ages.

name: Raratonga
description: An interactive water-based shooting attraction where riders board volcanic island-themed boats and must hit totem pole targets with water jets to appease the angry volcano Raratonga before it erupts and drenches the entire boat. Raratonga is one of the most joyfully participatory and social attractions at Mirabilandia — the competitive element of hitting targets while racing against other boats and the near-certain prospect of a thorough soaking creates genuine laughter and shared chaos. Perfect for families on a warm Adriatic summer day. Min. height: 90cm.

name: Gold Digger
description: A thrilling mine train coaster set in the atmospheric Old West gold rush landscape of Far West Valley — Gold Digger sends riders in runaway mining wagons through a compact but genuinely exciting layout of sharp curves, sudden drops and unexpected twists through mine tunnels and past gold rush scenery. Gold Digger is one of the most accessible and rerideable coasters at Mirabilandia and perfectly captures the adventurous spirit of the Far West themed zone. Min. height: 100cm.

name: Ducati World
description: A spectacular 35,000-square-metre area entirely dedicated to the iconic Italian motorcycle brand Ducati — Ducati World is a completely unique theme park experience that combines exciting riding simulators, MotoGP racing experiences, the world-exclusive Desmo Race spike dueling coaster, Ducati motorcycle exhibitions and immersive motorsport attractions in a celebration of Italy's most celebrated engineering achievement. The area was created in partnership with Ducati and features the most comprehensive collection of Ducati motorcycles on public display anywhere in the world alongside interactive racing experiences. Free access with park admission.

name: Police Academy Stunt Show
description: The most spectacular live action show at Mirabilandia and one of the finest stunt shows at any European theme park — the Police Academy Stunt Show features professional stunt drivers and riders performing extraordinary sequences of car chases, motorcycle stunts, explosive pyrotechnics and acrobatic feats in a purpose-built arena that seats thousands of spectators. The show famously recruits volunteers from the audience to participate in comedy sequences and the performers have worked on major Italian television productions including Distretto di Polizia and Carabinieri. The most comprehensively entertaining show available at Mirabilandia and a must-see at every visit. Suitable for all ages.
